module_metadata.purpose: Canonical 16-part script ordering, GDScript 2.0 keywords, Godot 4.5-4.7 annotations (@abstract, @export_tool_button), variadic functions (...args: Array), Typed Dictionaries, raw Variant exports, and uid:// preloading.

abstract_classes_and_methods_4_5_plus.rule: Any class containing at least one `@abstract func` MUST also be marked `@abstract` at the top of the file. Abstract classes cannot be instantiated directly (`StateBase.new()` throws an error), and non-abstract subclasses MUST implement all `@abstract` methods with matching signatures.

variadic_functions_4_5_plus.rule: Use `...param_name: Array` as the final parameter to accept an arbitrary number of trailing arguments.

raw_variant_exports_4_5_plus.rule: Exporting a raw `Variant` provides a dynamic type-selector dropdown in the Godot Inspector.

uid_preloading_and_exports_4_4_to_4_7.syntax:
const MyScene := preload("uid://d4f8a9b2c1e0")
@export_file("*.tres", "*.res") var fallback_item_uid: String = ""
uid_preloading_and_exports_4_4_to_4_7.rule: Godot 4.5-4.7 supports `uid://` strings directly in `preload()` and `load()`, making references immune to file moves.

export_tool_button_4_4_plus.rule: Requires `@tool` at top of script. Creates a clickable Inspector button without writing an EditorInspectorPlugin.

strict_override_return_paths_4_7_breakin.rule: In Godot 4.7, overriding a method with a typed return signature (`-> bool:`, `-> int:`, `-> Variant:`) strictly requires EVERY code branch to return a value at compile time.
